title: Normanton Gaol

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified terrain at Queensland’s mapped Normanton Gaol point.

mapIdentity.provider: Queensland Reconstruction Authority roof outlines and Queensland topographic building points
mapIdentity.scope: Queensland building data supplies two independent roof envelopes. Three topographic points name Normanton Gaol at those envelopes, on the registered site or immediately adjoining its surveyed edge. The larger southwest outline covers the cell ranges; the small rear outline contains the quarters. Open yard walls are inferred inside the heritage site.

note: The official heritage description identifies one-storey concrete cells, 3.5 m courtyard walls, the core’s hipped skillion and two roof ventilators, the later pitched roof and three ridge ventilators, and the hipped weatherboard quarters with a covered porch.
